Figure 2:Overview of Lab2Sim construction. Videos are collected and screened, a gold specification grounded in video frames is built for each video, and fixed templates turn the specification into rubric items.

Figure 3:Overview of EduVideo2Code. HPE extracts an evidence-grounded procedurePPfrom the video; SMG compilesPPinto a state machineMMand generates the page; EBV runs the page in a browser and, if its score is below the threshold, triggers targeted repair until the page is accepted or the repair budget is used up.

Figure 4:Qualitative comparison on two Lab2Sim experiments. Each row shows a key step of the reference video and the state reached in generated environment after the demonstrated operations are replayed. Stickers mark failure types: blank page (BP), wrong experiment (WE), wrong apparatus (WA), and non-executable operation (NO).
